- Keyboard: the bar opens with the usual words and is never empty at the start of a field; custom text boxes that declare no input type also get the bar.
- Processes: the load of each process is the load now (read in one go through the shell), not the average since it began, so the figures are no longer too high.
- App manager: the list is read in the background at start, so the page opens already filled; the action icons are the look's own coloured icons, with Fluent glyphs for Force stop and Extract APK.
- What's new: the list shown after an update is the list of this version (it showed an old version's notes).
- Windows desktops: a long press on the empty desktop, on a shortcut or on an app opens its menu again (the empty-desktop tap was swallowing it); desktop shortcuts, files and addresses have menus; on an icon the long press moves it and lifting without moving opens the menu.
- Windows 7: a real "Starting Windows" animation (four lights gather into the flag with a glow), a larger waving flag on the start orb, the Log off button text fixed.
- Windows 11: the taskbar and the quick settings are acrylic (the desktop picture shows blurred through them), the start logo is the blue Fluent logo and the buttons start at the left; the quick tiles are switches that turn things on and off in place (with root or Shizuku; without them they open the settings page); the music player is a Fluent player (Mica, round play button) in Windows 11 and 10 windows.
- Each boot is its own: the Terminal look boots like a Linux console, Windows Phone with its flat logo and running dots.
